title: Prefill: indexer logits + exact top-k
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 baseline (INFRA 17:48, wzhao/k31ws-int b31121cf56, runs/INFRA/step_p/int-b31121c-nv-f16f8-prof; measured/20261118-1805-nvfp4-prefill.json); achievable = nvfp4_modelopt model at the same slice
gap_analysis: Stock per DSA layer (1 GPU, 3 x 5461 rows @ 78360 keys, 12 chunks of 512 MB): 2.222 ms = DeepGEMM sm100_mqa_logits 1.558 ms + trtllm_gvr2 BF16 top-k 0.648 ms + weights cast 0.026 ms (x24 = 53.3 ms/forward; the 61.5 ledger projection was high). Model achievable 1.394 ms/layer = idx_score 1.206 (bound: FP32 SIMT epilogue) + topk 0.188. Stock source shows the epilogue is packed BF16 (cvt.rn.relu.bf16x2.f32 + fma.rn.bf16x2, 34 instr per 32 heads), so the true issue floor at stock precision is about 0.66 ms/layer for the logits plus a few instr/element for an in-epilogue exact select -> derived achievable about 0.75 ms/layer (18 ms/forward): the model over-prices this family about 1.9x (model error, to report). Stock inefficiencies: logits kernel runs at about 2.3x the epilogue issue floor (1x-K MMA, BLOCK_Q 4, 3 math WGs) and writes 2.5 GB/layer of BF16 logits that the GVR top-k re-reads (0.65 ms/layer).
inefficiencies: MEASURED: GVR top-k 0.648 ms/layer re-reading materialised BF16 logits (12 chunk launches)
MEASURED: logits kernel 1.558 ms/layer vs ~0.66 ms epilogue issue floor (2.3x); HYPOTHESIS: 1x-K MMA + BLOCK_Q 4 + epilogue under-occupancy
Logits round trip through HBM (2.5 GB write + read per layer)
MODEL ERROR: idx_score epilogue priced as FP32 SIMT; stock math is packed BF16
rubin_features: 2x-K block-scaled MMA (mxf4 K128) via sm_107a descriptors
oversized shared memory for per-row histograms

Correctness: logits vs DeepGEMM (bitwise share), exact top-k vs torch reference
Perf at P3-16 shape vs 0.75 ms/layer floor; tune (WG count, BQ, multicast)

work.what: Selection fixes: key scales by one bulk copy (key rows in SF-atom order), weights in registers, fine (one bin per BF16 value) compaction histogram, rank tie cut, thresholds in smem
work.result: 5.15 ms/layer, still exact; instrumenting compaction counts/time (runs/P-IDX/fused9.log)

work.what: In-kernel stats (iid random logits): 11K inserts and ~9 compactions per token; each compaction stalls the CTA through the 2-stage accumulator ring
work.result: root cause of the slow select (compaction = several latency-bound passes with contended smem atomics)

work.what: Redesign: per-token histogram of buffered keys (one bin per BF16 value above a base) maintained by the token warp; threshold raised every tile by a warp scan (exact); compaction becomes one filter pass + rebase; ILP epilogue variant (both tokens loaded, early TMEM release)
